title: Palantir, Nvidia bring sovereign AI to Nvidia’s complex supply chain
description: Palantir and Nvidia are deploying sovereign artificial intelligence across Nvidia's supply chain. This collaboration integrates Nvidia's open AI models with Palantir's enterprise AI platform. The system aims to enhance supply chain visibility and speed up decision-making processes. Companies can post-train Nvidia's models on their own operational data.

title: AI has increased work, not replaced jobs at Policybazaar, says CTO Bibhu Krishna
description: Policybazaar's chief technology officer states AI writes most of its code. This AI assistance has doubled production releases and expanded engineering tasks. Developers' roles have increased, not been replaced by artificial intelligence. Human oversight remains crucial for customer-facing processes and decision-making. Policybazaar continues to hire developers, emphasising human responsibility over AI skills.
